0.DSCR:
The Reactor of the $$スフィア$$ known as the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$.
He pilots the massive mobile weapon $$尸逝天$$.
He has stated himself that he belongs to $$鬼宿$$, within the mysterious organization $$サイデリアル$$ to which $$ジェミニス$$ also once belonged, but the full extent of that organization's purpose and structure remains unknown.
A man of few words, he never shows emotion, even in battle.
He had come to Earth to execute $$アンナロッタ$$ for defying some order, but revealed himself to the people of Earth only just before $$時の牢獄$$ was destroyed.

1.DSCR:
A symptom that appears in those who were caught up in the $$時空震動|lc$$ caused by the mysterious being '$$テンシ$$' and yet survived.
Both eyes turn red, and the person falls into a state as if their emotions had died.
1.DSC2:
A symptom that appears in those who were caught up in the $$時空震動|lc$$ caused by the mysterious being '$$テンシ$$' and yet survived.
Both eyes turn red, and the person falls into a state as if their emotions had died.
This is caused by body and mind being overwhelmed by awe and fear after coming into contact with the power of the $$御使い$$.
Those from whom life force has been excessively absorbed by the $$霊子吸収システム$$ also sense the presence of the $$御使い$$, the destination to which that power is sent, and fall into the same symptoms.
In theory, it can be overcome by anyone with enough mental strength to throw off the pressure of the $$御使い$$, but for ordinary humans this is basically impossible.

2.DSCR:
A mysterious young man who pilots the mobile weapon $$アスクレプス$$.
As the action captain of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists, who call themselves 'those who watch over humanity's evolution', he serves as the Reformists' de facto leader.
He always wears a warm smile and has a gentle, graceful bearing.
The true aims of the $$クロノ$$ Reformists and of the man himself are unknown, but toward $$ジェミニス$$, the hidden power behind the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives, he faced them with a resolute attitude, at times taking a stance that could even be called arrogant.
Calling himself one of the 'cursed', he says he is a person from another world who is chasing the '$$テンシ$$', but in the final battle with $$ジェミニス$$, he gave up his life with his aims unfulfilled, in order to break $$ガドライト#pilot$$'s $$スフィア$$ of the '$$いがみ合う双子$$'.

3.DSCR:
A general term for the organizations that exist in each parallel world and have manipulated the history of humanity from the shadows.
Their members are hereditary, and there exist a supreme authority called the $$キング$$ and a decision-making body called the Council of Thirteen.
There are two opposing groups, called the Conservatives and the Reformists, who call themselves 'those who monitor humanity's evolution' and 'those who watch over humanity's evolution' respectively.
Of these, the Conservatives are the mainstream and hold strong influence over political and financial circles and the military. The oppression of Spacenoids in each parallel world was carried out on their orders.
In the $$時獄戦役$$, they cooperated with $$ガドライト#pilot$$ of $$ジェミニス$$ and acted according to his instructions.
3.DSC2:
A general term for the organizations that exist in each parallel world and have manipulated the history of humanity from the shadows.
Their members are hereditary, and there exist a supreme authority called the $$キング$$ and a decision-making body called the Council of Thirteen.
There are two opposing groups, called the Conservatives and the Reformists, who call themselves 'those who monitor humanity's evolution' and 'those who watch over humanity's evolution' respectively.
Of these, the Conservatives are the mainstream and hold strong influence over political and financial circles and the military. The oppression of Spacenoids in each parallel world was carried out on their orders.
In the $$時獄戦役$$, they cooperated with $$ガドライト#pilot$$ of $$ジェミニス$$ and acted according to his instructions.
The founding of $$クロノ$$ was triggered by humanity's landing on the surface of the Moon. Those who submitted to the message of the $$御使い$$ left behind there, 'Humanity is a species that is not permitted to evolve', and to that power have since managed the history of humanity... or, in other words, its evolution... under their direction.
Those who opposed this way of being founded the Reformists from within, but they were overwhelmingly inferior in strength, and those who tried to make the managers of humanity public were also silenced by means such as assassination.
After the invasion of $$蒼の地球$$ by $$サイデリアル$$, it became entirely a subordinate organization of the $$新地球皇国$$, but after its existence was made public and the Empire was overthrown, it gradually lost its power, fading away of its own accord.

4.DSCR:
The $$スフィア$$ that $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ seized from $$ジェミニア#robot$$.
It uses opposing human emotions as its activation key.
4.DSC2:
The $$スフィア$$ that $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$ seized from $$ジェミニア#robot$$.
It uses opposing human emotions as its activation key.
Its way of living while holding those contradictions is human itself, and it can be called a miniature of $$至高神ソル$$, the aggregate of the $$スフィア$$. For that reason, it had been surmised that when all twelve $$スフィア$$ were gathered, it would become the core that controls them.

5.DSCR:
A mysterious mechanism that controls $$次元力$$.
It corresponds to the 12 signs of the zodiac, each responding to movements of the human mind and manifesting its power.
It is normally mounted as a power source for mobile weapons, but as a $$スフィア$$'s operational stage advances, it can also be used as a superweapon.
5.DSC2:
A mechanism that controls $$次元力$$.
Its true nature is a fragment born when the phenomenon control system '$$至高神ソル$$', which awoke to self-awareness 12,000 years ago, shattered itself.
It corresponds to the 12 signs of the zodiac, each responding to movements of the human mind and manifesting its power.
It is normally mounted as a power source for mobile weapons, but as a $$スフィア$$'s operational stage advances, it can also be used as a superweapon.
The 12 types of $$スフィア$$ and their activation keys are as follows.
- $$偽りの黒羊$$: Activation key 'Lies'
- $$欲深な金牛$$: Activation key 'Desire'
- $$いがみ合う双子$$: Activation key 'Opposing Emotions'
- $$沈黙の巨蟹$$: Activation key 'Void'
- $$傷だらけの獅子$$: Activation key 'Endurance'
- $$悲しみの乙女$$: Activation key 'Sorrow'
- $$揺れる天秤$$: Activation key 'Will'
- $$怨嗟の魔蠍$$: Activation key 'Hatred'
- $$立ち上がる射手$$: Activation key 'Defiance'
- $$知りたがる山羊$$: Activation key 'Curiosity'
- $$尽きぬ水瓶$$: Activation key 'Love'
- $$夢見る双魚$$: Activation key 'Dreams'
There are stages to a $$スフィア$$'s awakening. At the First Stage it is no more than a high-output energy generating mechanism, but from the Second Stage it becomes able to control phenomena. However, awakening a $$スフィア$$ to the Second Stage requires an aptitude suited to that $$スフィア$$, so only chosen humans can use its power. Only once a $$スフィア$$ has been awakened as far as the Second Stage is its user called a Reactor for the first time, but at the same time, the $$スフィア$$'s backlash brings suffering from various symptoms. Because of this backlash, most humans with the aptitude to be a Reactor drop out, but once the further stage, the Third Stage, is reached, the backlash subsides. Also, a Reactor who has awakened a $$スフィア$$ to the Third Stage becomes able to use its power even when at a distance from the $$スフィア$$, and produces various effects called $$スフィア・アクト$$.
Furthermore, each $$スフィア$$ has its compatibilities, and to completely defeat a $$スフィア・リアクター$$ who has reached the Third Stage, one must throw a $$スフィア$$ of poor compatibility against them to seal their power. However, even this becomes almost meaningless once the final phase of the Third Stage is reached, but $$スフィア・リアクター$$s in that state had never fought one another before, so what result it would produce was not actually known.
Through the hyperspacetime restoration, the 8 $$スフィア$$ that had been incorporated into $$至高神Ｚ$$ were completely lost.

6.DSCR:
His full name is $$ガドライト・メオンサム$$.
Commander of $$ジェミニス$$, a special unit belonging to $$サイデリアル$$.
He was formerly the Reactor of the $$スフィア$$ of the $$いがみ合う双子$$, and piloted $$ジェミニア#robot$$, the strongest mobile weapon on Planet $$ジェミナイ$$.
He is also the strongest warrior among the $$ジェミナイド$$s, and like the other $$ジェミニス$$ members he fights by channeling psychokinetic power directly into his unit's controls, though his own strength is on an entirely different level even within $$ジェミニス$$.
Using the $$スフィア$$'s power, he can reverse the opposing emotions that sleep within human hearts, and used this power to sow chaos across the $$地球圏$$.
He had originally been sent to Earth as a watcher over $$時の牢獄$$, but seeing his home planet $$ジェミナイ$$ destroyed by persons unknown, he came to bitterly envy Earth's continued existence, protected as it was from the fundamental calamity even with no future of its own. As a result, he abandoned his original duty and now moves his $$ジェミニス$$ subordinates toward the opposite goal: the annihilation of Earth's humanity.
He loves idleness and drink, and normally passes his tedious, aimless days at a bar, watching the chaos he himself unleashed upon the world. His second-in-command $$アンナロッタ$$ scolds him often for his slovenly ways, but he has not the slightest intention of changing. In truth, though, this was all a way of covering up the powerful anger inside him, and the resignation of having nowhere to direct it, and it was this very duality that powered the $$いがみ合う双子$$, keyed to opposing emotions.
As for his level of awakening as a $$スフィア・リアクター$$, he calls himself a Third Stage, surpassing even $$ユーサー・インサラウム$$ and $$アイム・ライアード$$.
In the end, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ threw the balance of his opposing emotions into disarray, and the $$スフィア$$ was seized from him by $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$, bringing about his defeat.

7.DSCR:
A nation built on $$蒼の地球$$ by the interstellar military alliance $$サイデリアル$$.
It is called the '$$ガイアエンパイア$$', or 'the Empire'.
Its supreme ruler, $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, is also the ruler of all of $$サイデリアル$$.
In each area it subdues, it builds a $$ターミナル・ベース$$ as a stronghold, from which extend the $$次元力$$ supply lines called $$レイライン$$s. These are bundled at the strategic base $$セントラル・ベース$$, and the $$レイライン$$s extending from $$セントラル・ベース$$ are in turn gathered at the imperial capital $$ラース・バビロン$$.
With overwhelming force it trampled the Earth Federation Forces, who had been worn down by the $$時獄戦役$$, and in a short time brought nearly the whole Earth under its control.
7.DSC2:
A nation built on $$蒼の地球$$ by the interstellar military alliance $$サイデリアル$$.
It is called the '$$ガイアエンパイア$$', or 'the Empire'.
Its supreme ruler, $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, is also the ruler of all of $$サイデリアル$$.
In each area it subdues, it builds a $$ターミナル・ベース$$ as a stronghold, from which extend the $$次元力$$ supply lines called $$レイライン$$s. These are bundled at the strategic base $$セントラル・ベース$$, and the $$レイライン$$s extending from $$セントラル・ベース$$ are in turn gathered at the imperial capital $$ラース・バビロン$$.
With overwhelming force it trampled the Earth Federation Forces, who had been worn down by the $$時獄戦役$$, and in a short time brought nearly the whole Earth under its control.
In the decisive battle at the imperial capital $$ラース・バビロン$$, the executives $$エルーナルーナ$$, $$尸空#pilot$$ and $$バルビエル$$, and $$皇帝アウストラリス$$, were defeated, and the Empire was destroyed.
Most of the remaining soldiers left the $$地球圏$$, but some who had surrendered, captivated by the planet Earth, requested asylum.

8.DSCR:
The imperial capital of the $$新地球皇国$$.
Located in the eastern part of the Central Siberian Plateau, it is where the $$次元力$$ supply lines called $$レイライン$$s, extending from bases around the world, converge.
A fortress city centered on the Imperial Palace in which $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ resides, it boasts an impregnable defense together with the surrounding lines of defense.
8.DSC2:
The imperial capital of the $$新地球皇国$$.
Located in the eastern part of the Central Siberian Plateau, it is where the $$次元力$$ supply lines called $$レイライン$$s, extending from bases around the world, converge.
A fortress city centered on the Imperial Palace in which $$皇帝アウストラリス$$ resides, it boasts an impregnable defense together with the surrounding lines of defense.
It was built at the apex of the Earth's geomantic veins, and connecting each $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ that $$インサラウム$$ set up during the $$再世戦争$$ with $$ラース・バビロン$$ forms a regular pentagon. $$インサラウム$$ had also planned to set up a $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ at this location as its final point of conquest, but being forced to withdraw from Earth, it built its last $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ on the surface of Mars, at a position that is significant in terms of star charts in relation to it.

9.DSCR:
A general term for the extradimensional energy that exists among parallel worlds.
It is also known as the Power of Origin, or $$オリジン・ロー$$.
The first stage of utilizing $$次元力$$ is extracting energy from another dimension, producing amounts of energy that would be impossible under ordinary physics. Even Earth's current hyperspacetime physics has reached a level where this can be controlled to some degree.
However, the ultimate goal of utilizing $$次元力$$ is to elucidate and control the energy that 'establishes the world', which could be rephrased as 'control over phenomena'. In other words, if one could freely control the facts that make object A into object A, it would become possible to transform object A into object B. Likewise, if one could control the fact that oxygen and hydrogen combine to produce water, it would become possible to produce water from entirely different elements.
The most striking example of this is $$時空震動$$, which ignores spacetime itself and alters the very existence of the world - in other words, $$時空震動$$ is caused by $$次元力$$.
This is what is called a 'miracle', a power that could be called all-powerful, but this remains purely a theoretical conclusion, and no prospect of proving it has been established. However, research into the $$スフィア$$ suggests that the extraction and control of $$次元力$$ involves the 'will' of living beings.
9.DSC2:
A general term for the extradimensional energy that exists among parallel worlds.
It is also known as the Power of Origin, or $$オリジン・ロー$$.
The first stage of utilizing $$次元力$$ is extracting energy from another dimension, producing amounts of energy that would be impossible under ordinary physics. Even Earth's current hyperspacetime physics has reached a level where this can be controlled to some degree.
However, the ultimate goal of utilizing $$次元力$$ is to elucidate and control the energy that 'establishes the world', which could be rephrased as 'control over phenomena'. In other words, if one could freely control the facts that make object A into object A, it would become possible to transform object A into object B. Likewise, if one could control the fact that oxygen and hydrogen combine to produce water, it would become possible to produce water from entirely different elements.
The most striking example of this is $$時空震動$$, which ignores spacetime itself and alters the very existence of the world - in other words, $$時空震動$$ is caused by $$次元力$$.
This is what is called a 'miracle', a power that could be called all-powerful, but this remains purely a theoretical conclusion, and no prospect of proving it has been established. However, research into the $$スフィア$$ suggests that the extraction and control of $$次元力$$ involves the 'will' possessed by all matter.
Its essence lies in controlling phenomena as one wishes by controlling the will that dwells in all matter, and $$次元力$$ can be called the compelling force behind that. Therefore, if one can communicate one's will to them and manipulate them as one wishes, that becomes control over phenomena, and it can also be said that one has used $$次元力$$.

10.DSCR:
Its official name is the Holy Kingdom of $$インサラウム$$.
An absolute monarchy that once unified the Earth of a parallel world, with a history of roughly 2,000 years.
Sovereignty rests with the Holy King, its ruler, but a parliament also exists, and policy is carried out in the form of the Holy King approving its decisions.
Its defense organization, the $$アークセイバー$$, adhered to a policy of purely defensive warfare and had protected humanity from alien life forms and extraterrestrials, but it was defeated by the $$破界の王$$, and $$インサラウム$$ was destroyed.
Under the command of $$ユーサー・インサラウム$$, it invaded the $$ＡＤＷ$$, but with the death of $$ユーサー$$ it was defeated by the Earth Federation.
The surviving members of the $$アークセイバー$$ and the citizens were permitted to join the Earth Federation and came to take part in the settlement group bound for Mars.

12.DSCR:
$$次元力$$ is an energy that exists universally throughout the entire universe, but the third planet of the Solar System in the Milky Way galaxy, Earth, is said to be the optimal place to draw it out.
The twelve constellations of the zodiac are made up of those stars, among the stars that are masses of $$次元力$$, that have especially strong energy, and the Earth is positioned to gather $$次元力$$ from them. That $$次元力$$ is stored throughout the Earth and becomes the power that nourishes the land.
For that reason, those who seek to use $$次元力$$ as their own power try to take the Earth into their hands.

13.DSCR:
Short for '$$ＤＥＭ$$ (Dimension Extra Merchant) Corporation', a company that travels between parallel worlds.
It also refers to that corporation's mobile weapon series, '$$ＤＥＭ$$ (Dimension Energy Machinery)'.
$$ＤＥＭ$$ Corporation's employees call themselves dimensional merchants and take pride in doing business across a variety of parallel worlds.
$$ＡＧ$$ is one of their agent robots, but is currently cut off, unable to contact head office. With $$時の牢獄$$ destroyed, a change in that situation was hoped for, but contact remains impossible, and it is surmised that some kind of trouble has occurred.
13.DSC2:
Short for '$$ＤＥＭ$$ (Dimension Extra Merchant) Corporation', a company that travels between parallel worlds.

Later, through the confession of $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$, who is also $$ＡＧ$$, it came to light that its existence was a dummy.

14.DSCR:
A dimensional barrier that engulfed $$蒼の地球$$ and its surroundings.
Born from the $$新世時空震動$$, it transformed the world into one governed by a law under which the flow of time for living things gradually falls to zero.
Through the spacetime restoration at the end of the $$時獄戦役$$, the laws of the world were destroyed together with the dimensional barrier, and the time of living things returned to normal.
14.DSC2:
A dimensional barrier that engulfed $$蒼の地球$$ and its surroundings.
Born from the $$新世時空震動$$, it transformed the world into one governed by a law under which the flow of time for living things gradually falls to zero.
This was $$哀しみのサクリファイ$$'s means of halting evolution by taking the future away from humanity, and had the dimensional barrier been completed, the humanity of Earth could have lived forever. However, it came to be denied by the collective will of humanity.
Through the spacetime restoration at the end of the $$時獄戦役$$, the laws of the world were destroyed together with the dimensional barrier, and the time of living things returned to normal.

16.DSCR:
A term for the series of battles that began with the $$新世時空震動$$.
From the late stage onward, it mainly refers to the battles over the time-stasis phenomenon '$$エタニティ・フラット$$' brought about by the completion of $$時の牢獄$$, and it was supposed to be concluded upon confirmation of $$時の牢獄$$'s complete destruction.
However, with the appearance of $$翠の地球$$ and the invasion of $$サイデリアル$$, the time of its conclusion has become ambiguous.

18.DSCR:
This refers to $$柏葉真紀$$, a nurse who works at $$第２新東京市$$ Municipal General Hospital.
People connected with the Volunteer Club call her this out of affection.
She is a woman in charge of the patients with '$$血塗られた眼$$' who are hospitalized in a special room. Cheerful and caring, and attentive to the smallest details, she continues to nurse with devotion even those patients who show almost no emotion.
After the spacetime restoration, she hopes for the recovery of the patients, whose seizures have subsided.

proofread.reason: omitted subject: the hoping (kitai shite iru) is Maki, the entry's subject and researched female; the English passive dropped her, and 'seizures subsided' is a modifier of the patients (hassa no osamatta kanjatachi)

19.DSCR:
A patient who had been hospitalized in a special room of $$第２新東京市$$ Municipal General Hospital.
Caught up in a dimensional quake together with their family, the patient alone survived. Afterward, the phenomenon called '$$血塗られた眼$$' set in, leaving them in a state as if all emotion had been lost. Only the emotion of fear remains, and they sometimes cry out in fright at something in a sudden fit.
As the completion of $$時の牢獄$$ drew near, the number of seizures had been increasing, but after the spacetime restoration they have calmed down, and recovery is hoped for.

21.DSCR:
A shadowy secret society with many mysteries, manipulating the world from behind the scenes.
$$アマルガム$$ is the term for an alloy of mercury and other metallic elements, and its executives hold code names corresponding to metallic elements, such as Mr. K (Potassium) and Mr. Fe (Iron).
It is after the $$ウィスパード$$ and the Black Technology sleeping within them, and is hostile to $$ミスリル$$, which aims at their humanitarian protection.
21.DSC2:
A shadowy secret society with many mysteries, manipulating the world from behind the scenes.
$$アマルガム$$ is the term for an alloy of mercury and other metallic elements, and its executives hold code names corresponding to metallic elements, such as Mr. K (Potassium) and Mr. Fe (Iron).
It is after the $$ウィスパード$$ and the Black Technology sleeping within them, and is hostile to $$ミスリル$$, which aims at their humanitarian protection.
At the time of its founding, its ideal was to be an organization that protects humanity's future from war, but its nature changed amid the turnover of members, and protecting the vested interests of its members became its main purpose.
Its organizational form was a democratic one with no clearly designated leader, but it was later transformed into a dictatorial organization by $$レナード$$, who was advancing his own plans.

22.DSCR:
The administrative division consisting of $$聖天使学園$$, which was transferred to the Tokyo Bay area by the $$時空震動|lc$$, and its surrounding area.
The chairwoman of $$聖天使学園$$, $$クレア$$, who concluded the negotiations with the federal government, serves as the city's representative.
Its name derives from the mythology of the world they came from.

uncertain: kw 0: the brief says no Jigoku entry, but the Japanese DSCR is identical to the Jigoku pilot entry 396 (Shikuu), so its English was kept sentence by sentence with the names turned into tokens. Jigoku's 'Silent Giant Crab' became the token 沈黙の巨蟹.

沈黙の巨蟹 / 時の牢獄 / 怨嗟の魔蠍: the akurasu Z3.R Story Summary says 'Muted Crab', 'Time's Prison', 'Resentful Scorpion', while the Jigoku library and Jigoku UI say 'Silent Crab', 'Prison of Time'. I followed the wiki (wiki wins). The other nine Sphere names have no wiki source; they are my literal renderings and need review.
Jigoku English uses 'Prison of Time' for 時の牢獄 in already-shipped text. If that is kept, the proposed English should be changed once, in the glossary, and every token follows.
Spelling: the Jigoku reuse text (hospitalized, utilizing, defense, organization) is American, although LIBRARY_STYLE.md says British. I used American for consistency with the kept sentences.

テンシ = Tenshi and 御使い = Envoy: neither is in the wiki or the glossary. 御使い is written in the singular, but kw 3 has 彼等 for them; the two-way wording 'their direction' there keeps the ambiguity. Please decide the pair once for the whole game (Angel/Angels is a possible alternative).

ジェミニス: 'the hidden power behind the Chrono Conservatives, $$ジェミニス$$' in kw 2 reads as a group (also kw 3, kw 6 where it is Gadlight's unit). I used the token as a group name without plural. Jigoku's 'Geminiss' is probably an artefact.

kw 6: Jigoku's English said the Earth was protected from '$$バアル$$'s onslaught' where the Tengoku Japanese says 根源的災厄; I wrote 'the fundamental calamity' rather than name Baal, since the source does not. Also 地球圏 is 'the Earth Sphere' (Gundam usage), replacing Jigoku's tokenised 'Earth $$スフィア$$'.
kw 8: the Japanese has インサラム once (typo for インサラウム); I used the インサラウム token. 地脈 is 'geomantic veins', kept distinct from the レイライン.
kw 7/8: ターミナル・ベース, セントラル・ベース, レイライン are new tokens with literal English; singular/plural of the bases is left as the source has it.

New person names with no wiki entry (Emperor Australis, Elunaruna, Sacrifai of Sorrow) are romanisations of the katakana only; other pt_ agents may propose different spellings, so please reconcile them in the glossary.

kw 5: the blank spacer lines in the Japanese (a lone fullwidth space) are dropped; the activation-key table is a '- name: Activation key ...' list. 虚無 = 'Void', 反抗心 = 'Defiance', 意志 = 'Will' are my choices.
kw 5: 至高神Ｚ expands to the glossary English 'Supreme God Z / Hypsistos Z' (with a slash), which will read oddly in prose; token kept as required.

kw 19/20: patient's gender is not stated, so they/their and 'the patient' are used. 次元震 is written as the plain phrase 'dimensional quake', not a token. Spacetime restoration (時空修復) and hyperspacetime restoration (超時空修復) are plain phrases too, not tokens.
kw 13: 'その存在がダミー' - the referent of 'its existence' is taken to be the DEM Corporation, left as 'its existence'.
kw 21: the code names 'Mr. K (Potassium)' and 'Mr. Fe (Iron)' are literal English (from ミスタ・Ｋ（カリウム） etc.), not tokens.
kw 22: 理事長 = 'chairwoman' because the Jigoku briefs state that Crea is the chairwoman of Holy Angel Academy.
